svg.title: The pre-push review gate
svg.desc: How a review outcome becomes a push decision: the moon task calls the CLI, the CLI applies the verdict and the round budget, and the budget reads and writes the journal state.

g.text: PUSH AND CI ENTRY POINTS · MOON TASK, WORKFLOW
